plan.title: Deft Directive per issue, part B: Deft state in the dashboard and the Run on Deft switch
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: The operator split PAN-4820 into exactly two issues on 2026-11-02 and assigned this whole dashboard set (PAN-4820 WI-15..WI-29) plus the review-cycle view to PAN-4849. The surfaces share one contract, one state reader and one route file, and the DAG already lets a foreman fan out the frontend leaves; PRD section 11 names the three-sibling split if the operator prefers flywheel parallelism.

narratives.Problem: PAN-4820 shipped the per-issue Deft pipeline as lib and CLI code, but the dashboard shows none of Deft's state (scopes, escalations, gates, heartbeats, review cycle) and switching an issue needs the CLI.
narratives.Proposal: Add an fs-only Deft state reader with shared contract types, Deft routes (state, batched summary, pipeline switch, escalation resolve, scope sign-off, review cycle), Needs-you and question-dialog integration for escalations and deterministic menus, frontend surfaces on the live cockpit, board and tree, a Deft review-cycle panel reconstructed from Greptile comments and fix-batch commits, Run on Deft / Back to Overdeck menu actions, and docs.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No Overdeck reviewer, check, test agent or extra instruction is added to a Deft issue (AD-22); the optional second reviewer is PAN-4851.
- No Deft CLI is run by the dashboard server and no execSync is added.
- No new field on the contracts DerivedIssueState and no change to the board's derivation path (AD-19).
- No change to PAN-4820's install, merge guard, lift, archive or kickoff behavior.
- No reading of .deft/review-monitor.json (obsolete in Directive).
- No deterministic-menu parsing for Codex agents; their menus stay in the terminal.
- No persistence of review rounds; rounds are reconstructed for display only.
- No escalation surfacing in Needs-you when the issue has no work agent (the Decisions tab still shows them).
- No minimatch dependency and no glob matching beyond exact and directory-prefix entries.
- No file-size allowlist raise.

autoDecisions.summary: Plan from the PAN-4820 PRD WI-15..WI-29 and AD-9..AD-12, AD-19, AD-20, AD-22 unchanged except where the targets drifted.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue body says not to re-decide them; drift corrections are re-verification, which the issue asks for.

autoDecisions.summary: BD-1: scope view and scope DAG mount in the cockpit Plan tab (tasks and map sub-views), not in XBriefTab.
autoDecisions.rationale: XBriefTab is mounted only by dead IssueDigTabs and the buried PlanPane.

autoDecisions.summary: BD-2: gates and review-cycle panels mount in IssueOverviewTab after SpecialistStrip.
autoDecisions.rationale: That is where Overdeck's own review verdicts render; AD-22 says show Deft's steps the same way.

autoDecisions.summary: BD-3: the review lease is read from the <!-- deft:review-owner --> PR comment, not .deft/review-monitor.json.
autoDecisions.rationale: Directive made that file a no-op (record.ts:690-692, SKILL.md:693).

autoDecisions.summary: BD-4: review rounds are reconstructed from fix-batch commits and Greptile inline comments, labeled as reconstructed.
autoDecisions.rationale: Deft records no rounds and Greptile edits its summary in place.

autoDecisions.summary: BD-5: the review cycle gets its own lib module and route; the state reader stays fs-only.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps NFR-1 for the reader and the forge reads out of the 15 s cockpit poll.

autoDecisions.summary: BD-6/BD-7: 'not running' when no supported reviewer signal; verdicts use Deft's names CLEAN, NEW_P0_P1, PENDING, NO_REVIEWER_INSTALLED.
autoDecisions.rationale: Mirrors evaluateReviewerExpectation; the issue asks for an explicit not-running state; AD-22 asks for Deft's wording.

autoDecisions.summary: BD-8: escalations and menus live in src/lib/deft/pending.ts and enter enrichment beside the operator decision, outside the cached scan.
autoDecisions.rationale: agent-enrichment.ts has limited room, and escalation files change without the transcript changing.

autoDecisions.summary: BD-9/BD-10: answer mapping handles the dialog's note suffix; menus accept one verbatim option only.
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches AskUserQuestionDialog's two submit shapes and AD-11.

autoDecisions.summary: BD-11: the frontend learns 'is Deft' from GET /api/deft/issues; IssueActionState gains isDeftPipeline.
autoDecisions.rationale: The contracts DerivedIssueState does not carry deftPipeline and AD-19 forbids growing it.

autoDecisions.summary: BD-12: DeftIssueState carries installDrift and liftConflicts; the tree row shows spec drift and install drift separately.
autoDecisions.rationale: The architecture doc already promises drift, and the two drifts mean different things.

autoDecisions.summary: BD-14: component tests render from a golden JSON that the state-reader test proves equals the reader's fixture output.
BD-15: switch activity entries use source 'dashboard'.

autoDecisions.rationale: The operator assigned exactly this set to PAN-4849 when splitting PAN-4820; auto mode may not re-scope it.

Resolve a Deft escalation file and its route

narrative.Action: Add resolveDeftEscalation (AD-10 atomic rewrite, id regex ^esc-[0-9]{14}-[0-9a-f]{6}$) and notifyEscalationResolved in src/lib/deft/escalations.ts, and route POST /api/issues/:id/deft/escalations/:escId/resolve with a no-loss row. Full spec: .pan/drafts/PAN-4849.md WI-3.

items.title: Given an open escalation file, resolveDeftEscalation rewrites it with status 'resolved' and a resolution holding decision, resolvedAt, resolvedBy, note and answer, and leaves every other field unchanged.
A second call on the same id returns 'already-resolved' and the route answers 409.
An escId of '../x' returns 'not-found' and writes no file.
After a 200 the route sends a notice through deliverAgentMessage to agent-<issue> with caller 'deft-escalation-answer', and a delivery failure shows in the response body while the status stays 200.

metadata.parallelSafeReason: New module and fixtures plus an append to deft-state.ts, which state-reader (its predecessor) owns; nothing else edits these files.

narrative.Action: Add the DeftReviewCycle contract types and deriveDeftReviewCycle(input, now): reviewer presence (BD-6), Deft severity regexes, rounds reconstructed from fix-batch commits (BD-4), the five exit fields, Deft's verdict names (BD-7), and the deft:review-owner lease. Given a '**P0**' line inside a fenced code block, countSeverities returns p0 0 for that body.
